liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokin' From Shootin** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the main set finish, specifically the sequence from Smokin' through Gideon [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **banter - inviting up Ben from Band Of Horses**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **banter - this holy ground**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **Bermuda Highway**: back after 30 archived shows (411 days) [11]
- **The Bottle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **banter - introducing Brian Jackson**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **banter - hell of a time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **I'll Be Home For Christmas**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **mmj2011-12-14.tlm170.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording has nice sound, avoiding the usual boomy bass typical of MSG shows; Listener describes the recording as sounding fantastic [6][9]
- **mmj2011-12-14.tlm170.flac24**: audience recording; 28 songs; 149 min [2]
- **mmj2011-12-14.msg_acidjack**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 149 min [3]
- **mmj2011-12-14.nak300cp4.aud.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 149 min [4]. Said about its sound: Bass overload occurs in track four because the taper did not roll it off [4]
- **mmj2011-12-14.mg210.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Listener finds this audio clearer than the live experience due to high seating and echo [8]

## Around the show

- Ben Bridwell of Band Of Horses joined for vocals during the performance [1]
- Ben Bridwell and Brian Jackson joined the band, with full Band of Horses present [4]
- The concert at Madison Square Garden in New York City was sold out [12]
- My Morning Jacket performed to a sold-out crowd at Madison Square Garden [13]
- Brian Jackson performed with the band, and they covered The Bottle [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2011-12-14.tlm170.flac16**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: FOB Audience [1]. Also: Scott Bernstein recorded, mastered, tracked, and posted the audio file [1]
- **mmj2011-12-14.tlm170.flac24**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: FOB Audience [2]. Also: Scott Bernstein recorded, mastered, tracked, and posted the 24-bit audio file [2]
- **mmj2011-12-14.msg_acidjack**: taped by acidjack; transferred by acidjack; source: Schoeps MK41 (DIN, DFC, behind SBD)>KCY>Naiant littlebox>Sony PCM-M10 (24/44.1) [3]. Also: Acidjack originally recorded and produced the show for nyctaper.com [3]
- **mmj2011-12-14.nak300cp4.aud.flac16**: taped by mellotone; transferred by mellotone; source: Nakamichi 300-CP4's > Oade(CM) PMD661 > Audacity [4]
- **mmj2011-12-14.mg210.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Jon Pasternak; source: Microtech Gefell M210's>Oade M248>SBM-1>D8 [5]
